links.comparator_used: Conventional physician-led informed consent without ChatGPT assistance
links.outcome: Preoperative anxiety (STAI-1) after informed consent; also IC duration and postoperative quality of recovery (QoR-15)
links.effect: Adjusted postintervention anxiety mean difference 0.26 (95% CI -1.45 to 1.97), meeting the noninferiority margin of +5 STAI points; no between-group difference in ΔSTAI-1 (p = 0.533); median IC duration 10 minutes in both groups (p = 0.020 for the between-group difference); QoR-15 favored the control group (p = 0.019)
links.tradeoff: QoR-15 postoperative recovery score was better in the physician-led group (p = 0.019); IC duration differed significantly between groups (p = 0.020) despite equal medians; baseline anxiety was higher in the AI-assisted group (p < 0.01)
links.quote: After adjustment for baseline STAI-1 and STAI-2 scores, postintervention anxiety did not differ between groups (mean difference, 0.26; 95% CI: -1.45 to 1.97), confirming noninferiority.

design_hint: physician supervision of ChatGPT-assisted informed consent
